responsibility: Second utility module providing lower-level tree-analysis and expression-manipulation helpers used across the Ada GCC interface. It contains routines for peeling Ada wrapper/base types, inferring known alignment from address expressions, preserving semantic flags while rebuilding references, finding constant inner references, recognizing simple additive forms, and determining whether an expression is function-invariant and safely reusable, which supports layout decisions, folding, alias/alignment reasoning, and code-generation simplifications elsewhere in gigi.
